description: PikPak Downloader Integration - Cloud-based download alternative to qBittorrent using pikpakapi library

userStories.title: Create PikPakDownloader class skeleton with async bridge
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the base PikPakDownloader class with async/sync bridge pattern so it can wrap the async pikpakapi library.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `backend/src/module/downloader/client/pikpak_downloader.py`
Class `PikPakDownloader` with `__init__(self, username: str, password: str)`
Implement `_run_async(self, coro)` method using asyncio.new_event_loop().run_until_complete()
Store `self._client = PikPakApi(username=username, password=password)` from pikpakapi
Hard-coded `CLOUD_FOLDER = 'AutoBangumi'` constant
Add `pikpakapi` to `backend/requirements.txt`
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Integrate PikPak into downloader factory
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the DownloadClient factory to instantiate PikPakDownloader when type is 'pikpak'.
acceptanceCriteria: Modify `__getClient()` in `backend/src/module/downloader/download_client.py` to handle `type == 'pikpak'`
PikPakDownloader uses `username` and `password` from settings (ignores `host`, `ssl`)
Export `PikPakDownloader` from `backend/src/module/downloader/client/__init__.py`
Import uses: `from .pikpak_downloader import PikPakDownloader`
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement PikPak authentication with token persistence
userStories.description: As a user, I want my PikPak session to persist across server restarts so I don't need to re-authenticate frequently.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement `auth()` method that calls `self._client.login()`
Token saved to `/config/pikpak_token.json` after successful login (JSON format with access_token, refresh_token, expires_at)
On `__init__`, load token from file if exists and valid (not expired)
Implement `_save_token()` and `_load_token()` helper methods
Implement `logout()` method that clears token file
Implement `check_host()` method that returns True if PikPak API is reachable (try login or refresh)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement torrent download functionality
userStories.description: As a user, I want to download anime via PikPak when the RSS engine finds new episodes.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement `add_torrents(self, urls: list, save_path: str, ...)` method
Accepts magnet URLs - use `self._client.offline_download()` for magnets
Creates folder structure in PikPak: `AutoBangumi/{save_path}/`
Implement `_get_or_create_folder(self, path: str)` helper that creates nested folders
Returns `True` on success, raises exception on failure (fail fast)
Extract and store torrent hash from magnet link (btih: parameter) in `self._hash_map`
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement torrent status retrieval
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see download progress when I open the torrent dialog in the web UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement `torrents_info(self, category=None)` method that calls `self._client.offline_list()`
Map PikPak phases to qBittorrent-compatible states: PHASE_TYPE_PENDING->stalledDL, PHASE_TYPE_RUNNING->downloading, PHASE_TYPE_COMPLETE->completed, PHASE_TYPE_ERROR->error
Return list of dicts with: hash, name, state, progress (0.0-1.0), save_path
Implement `get_torrent_path(self, torrent_hash: str)` that returns cloud path for hash
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement file renaming via PikPak API
userStories.description: As a user, I want downloaded files to be renamed to media server format so Jellyfin/Plex can identify them.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement `torrents_rename_file(self, torrent_hash: str, old_path: str, new_path: str)` method
Use PikPak API file rename endpoint via `self._client.rename_file()` or equivalent
Returns `True` on success, `False` on conflict or file not found
Log rename operation for debugging
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement file move via PikPak API
userStories.description: As a user, I want files to be reorganized when I update a bangumi's settings so my media library stays organized.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement `move_torrent(self, hashes: list, new_location: str)` method
Creates target folder structure if it doesn't exist using `_get_or_create_folder()`
Use PikPak API file move endpoint via `self._client.move_file()` or equivalent
Returns `True` on success
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement torrent deletion
userStories.description: As a user, I want to delete torrents from PikPak when I remove a bangumi subscription.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement `torrents_delete(self, torrent_hash: str)` method (or `delete_torrent`)
Removes both in-progress offline tasks and completed files from PikPak
Use `self._client.delete_offline_task()` for tasks and file delete for completed files
Returns silently if task/file not found (idempotent)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement existing hash tracking
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to track which torrents are already in PikPak to avoid duplicate downloads.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement `get_existing_hashes(self, category=None)` method
Extract hash from offline task URL (magnet btih) or task params
Return set of torrent hashes (lowercase, 40-char hex strings)
Used by SeasonCollector to deduplicate before adding
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Stub unused methods for API compatibility
userStories.description: As a developer, I need stub implementations for methods not applicable to PikPak.
acceptanceCriteria: Stub `rss_add_feed()`, `rss_remove_item()`, `rss_get_feeds()` - return empty/pass with docstring explaining 'AB RSS is independent'
Stub `rss_set_rule()`, `get_download_rule()`, `remove_rule()` - return empty/pass
Stub `prefs_init()` - no-op
Stub `add_category()`, `set_category()` - log debug message, return (PikPak uses folders)
Stub `add_tag()` - no-op
All stubs have docstrings explaining why they're stubs
Typecheck passes
